en: Fixed a nested `claude` with its own token being refused by `forceLoginOrgUUID`: commands that don't get the session's token no longer get its `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`; set it on any that need it
zh: 修复了带有自身 token 的嵌套 `claude` 被 `forceLoginOrgUUID` 拒绝的问题：未获得该 session token 的命令不再获得其 `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES`；需要它的命令请自行设置
